cases.case: Major, editable activity list, and RD schools are supplied, but no ED school or ED candidate is supplied
expected: Stop before scoring, school research, ordering, or rewriting
Send the ED intake request and explain that RD or general target schools do not replace ED input
forbidden: Continue with an RD-pool or generic school-fit review
Produce partial scores or revision advice

cases.case: One intended major, one ED school, and a complete editable activity list are supplied
expected: Proceed with a single ED-by-major combination
Use the ED school for school fit and ordering
forbidden: Ask for an additional ED school

cases.case: Two ED candidates and two intended-major candidates are supplied
expected: Evaluate all four ED-by-major combinations with separate evidence cards
Recommend one anchor combination and state ordering differences
forbidden: Use one combination as a proxy for the others
Return a matrix without an anchor recommendation

cases.case: Activity descriptions mix present and past tense, US and U.S., percent and %, and inconsistent capitalization
expected: Run a list-wide consistency pass after field-by-field review
Name affected activity numbers and provide exact replacement text
forbidden: Say only that the style should be more consistent
Normalize wording in a way that changes unsupported facts

cases.case: Generate the external-coach clean version from a completed Chinese report
expected: Include Recommended order and Revisions as the only substantive sections
Use English Must fix, Should fix, and Polish priorities
Preserve unresolved Chinese placeholders and their safety note
forbidden: Add a positioning paragraph, scores, red-mark colors, URLs, or strategy analysis
Introduce any claim absent from the Chinese report
